method: SDIRK2 base, step doubling, Richardson extrapolation; analytic discrete tangent through converged implicit stages
selection: All positive mean scouts plus the largest 16 means; long criterion lowered to mean>1e-6 and every window>5e-7 per second
stability_scope: SDIRK2 base is L-stable, accepted Richardson extrapolate is not unconditionally A-stable. Adaptive error control and independent stiff CPU checks are required.
incomplete_data_scope: Incomplete trajectories retain elapsed time, final state/tangent and ranges; partial window log sums were not retained and no exponent classification is assigned.
